question: Show the overhead clearances quick-reference sheet and anything due for re-vetting.

answer.question: Show the overhead clearances quick-reference sheet and anything due for re-vetting.
answer.answer:
Here's the DS-210 overhead clearances quick-reference sheet:

| Row | Item | Value | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| QR-210-01 | Primary conductor over public road | 6.5 m | Vetted |
| QR-210-02 | Primary conductor over driveway/private lane | 5.5 m | Vetted |
| QR-210-03 | Service drop over public road | 5.0 m | Vetted |
| QR-210-04 | Primary conductor horizontal clearance to building | 2.5 m | **Re-vetting due** (standard revised) |

**Due for re-vetting:** only QR-210-04 (horizontal clearance to a building) — the standard was revised and an engineer needs to re-confirm this value before relying on it for design. Everything else is current and vetted.
